description: This file defines an implementation of a durable, persistent, thread-safe queue for the Orleans distributed framework. It includes an interface for the queue, a class implementing the queue with state management and serialization support, and a debug view class.

classes.name: DurableQueue<T>
classes.description: A durable, persistent queue implementation supporting serialization and state management, suitable for use in distributed systems.

classes.name: DurableQueueDebugView<T>
classes.description: A debug view class for inspecting the contents of the DurableQueue in debugging environments.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the queue and appends a clear command to the storage log.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Returns the item at the beginning of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: TryPeek
methods.description: Attempts to return the item at the beginning of the queue without removing it, indicating success.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the queue.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the elements of the queue to an array starting at a particular index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator that iterates through the queue.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the queue and logs the enqueue command.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the beginning of the queue, logging the dequeue command.

methods.name: TryDequeue
methods.description: Attempts to remove and return the item at the beginning of the queue, indicating success.
